name: receipt-card
title: Receipt card
description: A printable signed receipt for one action.

files.content:
import type { ReceiptCardProps } from '../schemas' import { cx, formatWhen } from './util' /** A signed receipt for one action. Signature validity comes from your verifier, passed in as `signers`. */ export function ReceiptCard({ title, issuedAt, rows, hash, signers, className }: ReceiptCardProps & { className?: string }) { const allValid = signers.every((s) => s.valid) return (

{title}

{allValid ? 'signatures valid' : 'signature problem'}

Issued {formatWhen(issuedAt)}

{rows.map((r) => (
{r.label}
{r.value}
))}
sha256 {hash}
{signers.map((s) => {s.party}: {s.valid ? 'valid' : 'invalid'})}
) }
